currentParagraphText: “Yeah, I have,” Caleb nodded. “Mom and Dad... they aren’t cut out for this world the two of us live in. Not really. I tried to bring up the topic several times and in several different ways, but at this point, I’ve just accepted it. They aren’t fighters, and I don’t think we can make them fighters either. Even if we somehow could, would we really want to turn them into something they never wanted to be in the first place?”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: Jake was quiet as he considered Caleb’s words for a while, as well as everything he’d seen over these last few weeks. The average person wasn’t a fighter. The average person wasn’t suited to get powerful. But, perhaps more importantly, the average person wouldn’t gain any happiness from being powerful.
